name: Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd
summary: Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Australia. It explores for gold, rare earth elements, and copper deposits. The company was formerly known as Labyrinth Resources Limited and changed its name to Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd in February 2025. Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.
